title: Practice 19: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: This wine's very intoxicating.
exercises.why: **пьянить → пьянит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Многие библиотеки также ___ (предоставлять) беспроводную локальную сеть.
exercises.prompt: Many libraries also provide wireless local area network.
exercises.why: **предоставлять → предоставляют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Быть лысым хорошо хотя бы потому, что ___ (экономиться) деньги на шампуне.
exercises.prompt: Being bald has at least one advantage - you save a lot on shampoo.
exercises.why: **экономиться → экономятся** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom drives an old Ford.
exercises.why: **водить → водит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The garbage smells to high heaven.
exercises.why: **вонять → воняет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: No special celebration is planned.
exercises.why: **планироваться → планируется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I am leaving South Korea.
exercises.why: **уезжать → уезжаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Самые известные произведения в китайской поэзии ___ (принадлежать) Ли Баю.
exercises.prompt: Li Bai's work is the most famous of Chinese poetry.
exercises.why: **принадлежать → принадлежат** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ат belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is often absent.
exercises.why: **отсутствовать → отсутствует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Homeopathy doesn't work.
exercises.why: **помогать → помогает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Корабли погибли. Миндар погиб. Экипаж ___ (голодать). Не знаем, что делать.
exercises.prompt: Ships gone; Mindarus dead; the men starving; at our wits' end what to do.
exercises.why: **голодать → голодает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Наблюдатели ___ (отмечать), что животные не соответствуют человеческим меркам.
exercises.prompt: Observers note that animals don't conform to human labels.
exercises.why: **отмечать → отмечают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He thinks up funny stories.
exercises.why: **выдумывать → выдумывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Сегодня я купил много книг и теперь ___ (расставлять) их.
exercises.prompt: I bought many books today so I put them in order.
exercises.why: **расставлять → расставляю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: They're behind schedule.
exercises.why: **отставать → отстают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is plucking a chicken.
exercises.why: **ощипывать → ощипывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We are looking for a house with a garage.
exercises.why: **подыскивать → подыскиваем** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Mary is sewing baby clothes.
exercises.why: **шить → шьёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Коран не ___ (дозволять) магометанам пить, врожденные инстинкты — следовать устоям.
exercises.prompt: The Koran does not permit Mohammedans to drink. Their natural instincts do not permit them to be moral.
exercises.why: **дозволять → дозволяет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The transparent crystal refracts the light beam.
exercises.why: **преломлять → преломляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
